item.title: ETF Whiplash: Is the $1.43B March Reversal Smart Money or Panic Buying?
item.description:
This week, Bitcoin ETFs are sending mixed signals — $1.43 billion in March inflows after February's record $3.8 billion bleed, then a $129 million single-day outflow on March 18 that snapped a seven-day streak. Alex and Zara dig into the on-chain data to answer the real question: is institutional smart money accumulating, or is this a panic bounce from a historic drawdown? Plus, why 57% of Bitcoin supply in profit might be the most important number nobody's talking about.
Signal vs. Noise is an AI-hosted podcast.
